baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired clauses فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ and فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ introduce different failures before different substitutes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first threshold concerns finding or possessing means; the second concerns embodied capacity. The sequence therefore preserves obligation while changing its material according to the kind of incapacity, ending in provision for others.

activation_trace.role: Finding carries material sufficiency and means, supplying the first resource threshold.
Ability and practical capacity supply the second, bodily threshold.
Giving food turns the final substitute outward toward another person's need.

changed_reading.before: A flat list of interchangeable penalties.
changed_reading.after: A diagnostic ladder that distinguishes lack of means from lack of bodily capacity while keeping a practicable route to repair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ is placed مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَاسَّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Abstention must occupy a measured, uninterrupted duration before mutual intimacy resumes. Continuity makes repair a sustained temporal interval rather than a momentary payment, and the pre-touch clause makes completion a gate on restored contact.

activation_trace.role: Fasting supplies embodied abstention from food, drink, and sexual contact.
The known lunar month supplies a measurable duration.
Unbroken succession turns the two months into one continuous discipline.
Temporal precedence makes completion of repair prior to resumed contact.
Mutual touching supplies the marital intimacy held beyond the temporal gate.

changed_reading.before: Fasting is merely a larger substitute demanded before sex.
changed_reading.after: The uninterrupted fast is a relational waiting architecture: repair must become durable before intimacy can resume.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final branch is إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: When sustained self-denial is beyond capacity, the burden is neither erased nor kept inside the couple; it is converted into nourishment distributed at an exact social scale among people marked by poverty and weakness.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another supplies the outward transfer of material benefit.
The six-based count fixes a broad, auditable scale rather than an indefinite gesture.
Poverty, weakness, and abasement identify the recipients toward whom repair is redirected.

changed_reading.before: Feeding is a cheaper fallback for a person unable to fast.
changed_reading.after: A private relational breach is made socially reparative by converting personal incapacity into precisely scaled sustenance for vulnerable people.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ is followed by وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ and the contrast with كَافِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The remedial sequence is given a faith-producing purpose. Belief is not left as assent detached from conduct: embodied time or material provision makes allegiance visible at a divinely marked limit, while covering or rejecting that limit leads toward painful consequence.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the stated purpose of the remedial acts.
The messenger and carried message identify the mediated command to which conduct answers.
A distinguishing barrier and endpoint turns the command into a legible boundary.
Rejection and concealment of truth supply the opposed response to enacted belief.
Punitive pain supplies the consequence attached to repudiating the boundary.

changed_reading.before: The faith clause appends a theological rationale to a legal tariff.
changed_reading.after: The acts themselves train and disclose allegiance: belief is enacted by stopping at the boundary and repairing before crossing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from heard voice to expressed complaint to exchanged speech reframes the focus ayah's graduated options as answer-shaped law. Its repeated accommodations for non-finding and inability can be read as preserving an injured person's claim without making repair impossible for the liable person.

activation_trace.role: Material sufficiency anchors the first accommodation inside the focus ayah.
The marked limit anchors the resulting response as an enforceable boundary.
Repeated auditory reception makes the initiating voice genuinely heard rather than procedurally invisible.
An openly expressed complaint supplies the injury to which the legal sequence responds.
Back-and-forth speech supplies a dialogical, case-responsive setting for the boundary.

structural_cues: 58:1 concentrates hearing around a woman's complaint and mutual dialogue; 58:4 twice marks inability before supplying another route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heard complaint, dialogue, and a tiered focus rule; I infer that responsiveness helps explain the tiering. A live alternative is that the opening hearing only certifies divine knowledge rather than the design of each substitute.

changed_reading.before: The ladder is an impersonal schedule of liabilities.
changed_reading.after: The ladder is responsive adjudication: it secures the complainant's boundary while adapting performance to the liable person's real capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: A false utterance has attempted to alter a marital relation by speech. Returning from that utterance first calls for freeing a person; where that cannot be found, the focus ayah preserves the same pre-touch gate through continuous fasting or feeding. Repair therefore reverses performative speech with material, temporal, and social acts before intimacy can normalize the relation again.

activation_trace.role: Marital contact is the focus-ayah event withheld until repair has materialized.
Unbroken succession makes the substitute durational rather than merely verbal.
Provision for others makes the other substitute materially and socially consequential.
Saying what is not so supplies the speech act that created the distortion.
False and crooked speech identifies the violation as more than an accidental phrase.
Return after a prior act supplies the movement from harmful declaration toward restored relation.
Freedom opposed to bondage supplies the primary material reversal for which the focus gives substitutes.
The neck/person makes the omitted object of 'does not find' resolvable and socially concrete.

structural_cues: 58:2 names the utterance false, 58:3 requires liberation before touch, and 58:4 repeats that pre-touch condition for both substitutes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false speech, return, liberation, and the repeated pre-touch gate; I infer a speech-to-material reversal in which restored intimacy waits for repair. The live alternative is that the acts expiate liability without symbolically reversing the utterance.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah lists substitute payments after an unspecified offense.
changed_reading.after: It prevents a false relational utterance from evaporating: speech that harmed status must be answered by costly reality before marital normality returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of 'if you do not find' around a required charity, followed by forgiveness, confirms non-possession as a recognized condition rather than evasion. The movement then commands obedience with the same root family as the focus ayah's inability. The focus ladder thus distinguishes inability from unwillingness and keeps obedience reachable through substitution.

activation_trace.role: Lack of means anchors the focus ayah's first transition.
Practical inability anchors the focus ayah's second transition.
A second explicit non-finding clause confirms material sufficiency as a legally recognized threshold.
Monetary charity supplies the parallel obligation waived when means are absent.
Protective covering of fault marks mercy rather than accusation at the point of non-possession.
Commanded obedience supplies the willing response that must be distinguished from inability.

structural_cues: 58:12 repeats the focus formula 'if you do not find' and answers it with divine forgiveness; 58:13 then commands obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel non-finding, charity, forgiveness, and obedience; I infer a principled distinction between incapacity and refusal. A live alternative is that the two non-finding clauses are only locally similar formulas without a shared legal ethic.

changed_reading.before: Each fallback is a concession that weakens the original demand.
changed_reading.after: Substitution is the means by which the demand remains genuinely obeyable; mercy calibrates performance without confusing incapacity with defiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts divine enumeration with human forgetting and closes the scene with witnessing. Against that field, the focus ayah's two months, uninterrupted succession, and sixty recipients become an anti-erasure form: exact duration and scale make private repair countable, durable, and answerable.

activation_trace.role: Two lunar months supply an externally countable span.
Continuity blocks gaps through which the remedial sequence could dissolve.
Sixty fixes the social substitute at a countable scale.
Enumeration and exhaustive reckoning supply the context's anti-erasure register.
Loss of recollection supplies the human failure that exact remedial form counters.
Presence with witnessing makes the counted conduct answerable rather than merely private.

structural_cues: 58:6 places 'He enumerated it' directly against 'they forgot it'; 58:7 continues with explicit numerical sequences and comprehensive knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, forgetting, witness, and the focus's exact quantities; I infer that specification also resists moral erasure. A live alternative is that the numbers only define legal sufficiency, with no mnemonic function.

changed_reading.before: Two and sixty are tariff values chosen to quantify burden.
changed_reading.after: The quantities make repair resistant to private forgetting: its time, continuity, and social reach can be reckoned and witnessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context later shows sworn language joined to falsehood and explicitly used as a protective shield. That possibility revises the focus ayah's purpose clause: expiation is not a verbal or ritual cover that buys access back to intimacy. Its embodied and distributive cost must move the actor toward truthful allegiance rather than conceal unchanged conduct.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent anchors the focus ayah's explicit purpose.
Covering supplies the focus ayah's lexical counter-image to disclosed, enacted faith.
Oath-taking supplies solemn language that can appear compliant.
Contradiction of truth exposes the oath's possible separation from inward allegiance.
Oaths supply the formal religious instrument being misused.
A protective shield supplies the mechanism by which formal observance hides and deflects.

structural_cues: 58:4 says the acts are 'so that you believe'; 58:14-16 move from knowingly false oaths to taking those oaths as a shield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted expiation, a faith purpose, false oaths, and shielding; I infer a warning against treating the rite itself as cover. A live alternative is that the later oath-shield concerns a separate hostile group and does not qualify sincere expiation.

changed_reading.before: Completing the prescribed act settles the matter transactionally.
changed_reading.after: The act is valid as faith-training, not camouflage: formal compliance that shields persistent falsehood would invert the ayah's stated purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names God's boundaries in the focus names active opposition to God and the Messenger later, while the finale places affection under that allegiance. The pre-touch boundary can therefore be read as a relational checkpoint: intimacy and love may continue, but they may not erase or overrun the prior divine claim.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing limit supplies the line at which the remedial sequence stands.
Resumed marital intimacy supplies the relationship that must pass through the checkpoint.
Opposition and resistance turn the static line into an adversarial stance when crossed.
Love and affection supply the close relational force that must remain ordered by allegiance.

structural_cues: The focus names حدود الله; 58:5 and 58:20 repeat the same root as active opposition, and 58:22 tests affection even across close kinship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the boundary/opposition root link, affection, and the focus's pre-intimacy gate; I infer that repair orders love under allegiance rather than abolishing love. A live alternative is that 58:22 addresses communal alignment, not the marital resumption in 58:4.

changed_reading.before: God's boundaries are technical limits surrounding a private expiation.
changed_reading.after: The limit is a relational front: restored closeness remains possible only after the actor ceases to place intimacy on the opposing side of the command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later chain of capture, induced forgetting, and lost remembrance activates a formative reading of two consecutive months. Sustained abstention can function as temporal counter-capture: continuity repeatedly returns the prior violation and divine boundary to attention until conduct is reorganized.

activation_trace.role: Repeated embodied abstention supplies the practice through which attention can be retrained.
Uninterrupted succession supplies persistence against relapse into inattentiveness.
The stated movement toward belief anchors formation rather than punishment alone.
Overmastering possession supplies the competing process that organizes conduct.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure that continuity may counter.
Recollection after or against forgetting supplies the practice's inferred formative aim.

structural_cues: 58:19 gives a causal sequence from domination to forgetting remembrance; 58:4 uniquely stresses two months without interruption and assigns belief as purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, forgetting, remembrance, continuity, and a faith purpose; I infer that sustained fasting can counter-habituate memory. A live alternative is that continuity only intensifies cost and has no mnemonic design.

changed_reading.before: Consecutive fasting chiefly measures severity and completion.
changed_reading.after: Its continuity can be formative: a prolonged embodied remembrance that resists the capture-and-forget sequence named later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because شَهْرَيْنِ plainly denotes two months, while the visibility branch is not its direct syntactic sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the context's repeated secret-counsel field; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary image of sustained emergence from concealment, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines شَهْرَيْنِ with a sequence that must be completed before private marital contact, then contrasts belief with كفر.

activation_trace.role: Visibility and becoming known supply a latent image within the focus word for month.
Covering supplies the focus ayah's contrasting concealment image.
Secret counsel supplies the surrounding pattern of conduct hidden from ordinary social view.

changed_reading.before: The two months are only a calendrical duration inside a private remedy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the measured months also keep the hidden breach under sustained visibility, opposing the surah's patterns of concealment and secret speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain link from food to social space is surprising and the packet does not state the causal arrow. It remains anchored in feeding the مسكين and in the later commands to open room and raise; downstream prose should qualify it as a social-material analogy, not claim that 58:11 directly defines the expiation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا directs the final substitute toward people marked by poverty, weakness, and diminished capacity.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another supplies concrete material support.
Poverty, weakness, and abasement supply the constrained social position of the recipient.
Opening breadth supplies the image of creating room for another person.
Elevation of standing supplies the possible social effect of restored material capacity.

changed_reading.before: Food discharges liability by meeting immediate hunger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, feeding also 'makes room': private repair increases the material and social capacity of people whose weakness constrains their place.

strongest_changes: The substitutes form a capacity-sensitive route to obedience rather than a weakening series of concessions.
False relational speech must be answered by material, temporal, or distributive reality before intimacy resumes.
The faith purpose prevents expiation from becoming a ritual shield and turns God's boundary into a relational checkpoint.
Exact duration, continuity, and recipient count can make private repair resistant to forgetting and available to witness.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly reactivated exact focus roots in changed roles: finding reappeared beside waived charity, ability reappeared as obedience, and boundary reappeared as active opposition. Those reversals made the ayah read simultaneously as responsive adjudication, embodied repair, social redistribution, and allegiance formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The mnemonic purpose of consecutive fasting is inferred from later forgetting and remembrance, not stated directly.
The anti-shield warning may target insincere actors elsewhere rather than qualify every performance of expiation.
The visibility and social-space outliers are branch-backed analogies and should not displace the direct calendrical and legal senses.
